payload.body_they: {{Name}} wants to be known for something that actually reflects who they are. The projects they lead, positions they take, standards they defend, and responsibilities they are willing to put their name on gradually become part of their reputation. Recognition can make changing direction harder once other people have decided what they are good at. What they become known for should still be something they would choose after people start expecting it from them.
